Aaargh, damn it...!! Dammit...! I can't 
stand this...!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"And here I thought I could win...! 
Snatching it right from under my nose...!"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
...Don't you talk down to me! You picking 
a fight or what!?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
I don't need no "Good Effort Award"! All 
I'm lookin' at... is a real victory!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"Tch! ...Anyway, I won't forget today! And 
mark my words! Next time, I'm taking first 
place for sure!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As she spoke, there seemed to be a 
distinct fighting spirit dwelling in her 
eyes.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Ngh, I already know... that muuuuch!!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Dammit, dammit... I'll win next time... 
Just you watch...!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"...Oi! From the sound of it, you've 
already got a new plan, haven't you?! 
...Let's hurry back and have a strategy 
meeting!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was so close this time... However, 
seeing her like this, I'm sure she will 
use this defeat as a stepping stone.
